title.zh: Ueno数字银行倒闭后巴拉圭总统辞职
title.en: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank

current_state.zh: 总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚在弹劾程序和Ueno银行危机中辞职；央行已公布首批储户赔付名单。
current_state.en: President Santiago Peña has resigned amid impeachment proceedings and the Ueno Bank crisis; the central bank has outlined an initial depositor payout group.

updates.title_zh: Ueno数字银行倒闭后巴拉圭总统辞职
updates.title_en: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
updates.what_changed_zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚在数字贷款机构Ueno银行倒闭后辞职，该事件导致数百万客户无法取回资金，并引发不断加深的政治危机。
updates.what_changed_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned after the collapse of digital lender Ueno Bank, which left millions of customers unable to access their funds and triggered a deepening political crisis.
updates.current_state_zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚在数字贷款机构Ueno银行倒闭后辞职，该事件导致数百万客户无法取回资金，并引发不断加深的政治危机。
updates.current_state_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned after the collapse of digital lender Ueno Bank, which left millions of customers unable to access their funds and triggered a deepening political crisis.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned after the collapse of digital lender Ueno Bank, which left millions of customers unable to access their funds and triggered a deepening political crisis.

updates.title_zh: Ueno银行危机之际巴拉圭总统培尼亚提交辞呈
updates.title_en: Paraguay’s Peña Submits Resignation Amid Ueno Bank Crisis
updates.what_changed_zh: 巴拉圭议员以78票通过弹劾程序，央行公布了Ueno银行储户的首批赔付名单。
updates.what_changed_en: Paraguayan lawmakers approved impeachment proceedings with 78 votes, and the central bank outlined an initial payout group for Ueno Bank depositors.
updates.current_state_zh: 总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚在弹劾程序和Ueno银行危机中辞职；央行已公布首批储户赔付名单。
updates.current_state_en: President Santiago Peña has resigned amid impeachment proceedings and the Ueno Bank crisis; the central bank has outlined an initial depositor payout group.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned as lawmakers voted 78 in favor of impeachment proceedings amid the Ueno Bank crisis, while the central bank outlined an initial payout group for depositors.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned as lawmakers voted 78 in favor of impeachment proceedings amid the Ueno Bank crisis, while the central bank outlined an initial payout group for depositors.
